purpose: A1 shooter placement ablations, A2 loss traces, and A6 episode-level potential prediction.
scope: Level 7 daytime lawn; deck 0-5; frozen development seeds 30000-30255; simulator build 2056e13ef46c9820.

variants.extra_rule: 射手满 20 后，sun>=50 就购买坚果，优先靠近威胁行并放在较高列

a1.conclusion: Widening shooting columns reduced wins; buying wall-nuts after 20 shooters matched the 20-shooter baseline within 1 game.

a6.sampling: one nonterminal state per episode at each exact wave; episode is the unit; same task and phase are controlled by exact wave.
a6.metric: AUC for potential ranking eventual win within each exact wave.
a6.conclusion: Potential has weak early discrimination (wave 1 AUC 0.466) and stronger late-stage discrimination (wave 25 AUC 0.879, n=227).
